prompt: Write a Python class LRUCache with __init__(self, capacity), get(self, key) returning the value or -1, and put(self, key, value). When capacity is exceeded, evict the least recently used key. Both get and put count as a use. Both must be O(1). Only output the code in one ```python block.
tests:
c=LRUCache(2)
c.put(1,1);c.put(2,2)
assert c.get(1)==1
c.put(3,3)
assert c.get(2)==-1
c.put(4,4)
assert c.get(1)==-1 and c.get(3)==3 and c.get(4)==4
c=LRUCache(1)
c.put(1,1);c.put(1,5)
assert c.get(1)==5
c.put(2,2)
assert c.get(1)==-1

prompt: Write a Python function min_rooms(meetings) that takes a list of (start, end) half-open intervals and returns the minimum number of rooms needed so no two overlapping meetings share a room.
